title: Cancellable product hosting for model planning in worker threads and background jobs
request: Host model planning with cancellation and real budgets, integrating decomposition and task planning with jobs and worker threads while keeping offline behavior functional.
plan: Design a PlanningHost context manager that supports thread-local and contextvar cancellation tracking.
Integrate PlanningHost with jobs.worker.Control checkpoints and ensure Stopped BaseException propagates without being swallowed.
Update _deadline in decomposer.py to delegate to active hosts in worker threads while preserving signal.setitimer on POSIX main thread and refusing unhosted threads.
Integrate planning_host into orchestra service walk_project for safe asyncio.to_thread execution.
Add comprehensive test suite covering host activation, cancellation, jobs Stop propagation, unhosted refusal, and failure tracking.

decisions.decision: Support both explicit planning_host contexts and automatic jobs.worker.Control discovery.
decisions.why: Background jobs already have durable cancellation via checkpoint and should not require manual wrapper boilerplate.

decisions.decision: Preserve strict refusal with deadline_unavailable for unhosted worker threads.
decisions.why: Background threads that cannot guarantee cancellation or bounded execution must not be permitted to make unbounded model requests.

decisions.decision: Allow Stopped BaseException to propagate cleanly through planning functions.
decisions.why: A user-requested job stop must abort the worker job immediately rather than falling back to deterministic planning.

decisions.decision: Preserve planner.py byte-for-byte to maintain TP-03 frozen development comparison hashes.
decisions.why: Modifying planner.py would invalidate historical dev comparison fingerprints from prior accepted packages.

change: Add PlanningHost in dclab_rnd/tasks/host.py, update _deadline in decomposer.py to support cancellable hosts in worker threads, wrap walk_project in orchestra/service.py, and verify with 9 new tests across 12 test files.

findings.defect: Modifying planner.py invalidated historical TP-03 development comparison fingerprint.
findings.scenario: Importing _Refusal into planner.py altered its sha256, causing test_recorded_dev_comparison_matches_current_prompt_code_and_fixture to fail.
findings.cause: evaluate_plans.py checks sha256 of planner.py against frozen baseline in task_planning_tp03_dev.json.
findings.fix: Revert planner.py and allow _Refusal to be handled as an Exception returning proposal_refused during fallback.
findings.impact: Frozen dev gate regression would block package acceptance.
alternatives: Regenerate frozen evaluation record (violates immutability rule)

findings.defect: decompose report uses refusals list rather than fallback_reason key.
findings.scenario: A test inspecting report['fallback_reason'] crashed with KeyError.
findings.cause: decompose finish helper stores refusal reasons in report['refusals'].
findings.fix: Assert against report['refusals'] matching decompose specification.

measurements.name: Cancellable planning host suite
measurements.gate: All 9 host tests must pass with zero skips across thread, cancellation, and jobs integration paths.
measurements.result: 9 tests passed in 3.5s with zero failures and zero skips.
limits: Tests verify host cancellation and boundary plumbing using scripted transport fixtures.

measurements.name: Full task planning suite
measurements.gate: All 12 task planning test files must pass with zero regressions.
limits: Execution rollout remains disabled by default pending formal promotion gate rerun.

outcome: Cancellable product hosting for model planning is complete with PlanningHost, seamless jobs.worker integration, worker-thread support in walk_project, and 366 passing tests.
lessons: Frozen evaluation records require strict byte-level preservation of hashed source files.
BaseException subclasses like Stopped provide a clean mechanism to bypass standard domain Exception handlers for job cancellation.
risks: Worker threads running without planning_host will continue to refuse planning before invoking models.
